en.answer: That <<10875>> can still only be used for the Synchro Summon of a Warrior-Type monster, and it is still banished.
en.question: If I target an opponent's <<10875>> with the card <<9241>>, and use it for a Synchro Summon, what happens?
en.title: If I target an opponent's <<10875>> with the card <<9241>>, and use it for a Synchro Summon, what happens?
